blocks.tamil_translation: Those who believed, left their homeland and strove in the path of Allah with their wealth and their lives are of the highest rank with Allah — and it is they who are the successful. Their Rabb gives them glad tidings of mercy from Himself, of His good pleasure, and of gardens of Jannah — in them they will have everlasting bliss. They will abide in them forever; indeed Allah — with Him is a mighty (good) reward.

blocks.arabic_text: وَقَالَ تَعَالي: (وَالَّذِينَ جَاهَدُوا فِينَا لَنَهْدِيَنَّهُمْ سُبُلَنَا ؕ وَإِنَّ اللهَ لَمَعَ الْمُحْسِنِينَ۞).
blocks.tamil_translation: Those who strive (to go) in Our Din — We will surely show them Our (straight) ways; indeed Allah is with those who do good.

blocks.arabic_text: وَقَالَ تَعَالي: (وَمَنْ جَاهَدَ فَإِنَّمَا يُجَاهِدُ لِنَفْسِهِ ؕ إِنَّ اللهَ لَغَنِيٌّ عَنِ الْعلَمِينَ۞).
blocks.tamil_translation: And whoever strives (in the path of Allah) strives only for (the good of) him(self); indeed Allah is free of need of all the worlds.

blocks.arabic_text: وَقَالَ تَعَالي: (إِنَّمَا الْمُؤْمِنُونَ الَّذِينَ امَنُوا بِاللهِ وَرَسُولِهِ ثُمَّ لَمْ يَرْتَابُوا وَجَاهَدُوا بِأَمْوَالِهِمْ وَأَنْفُسِهِمْ فِي سَبِيلِ اللهِ ؕ أُولئِكَ هُمُ الصّدِقُونَ۞).
